title: Verify customer identity before portal access
user_story: As a delinquent customer, I want to verify my identity using core account attributes, so that my confidential financial details remain protected.
business_value: Prevents unauthorised data disclosure and complies with UK banking data protection standards while enabling self-service.
acceptance_criteria: Account details and balances remain completely hidden until all identity verification criteria succeed; Verification matches customer-entered DOB, postal code, and account reference against legacy records; Failed attempts increment an unverified counter and present a clear retry prompt.
notes: Assumes customer demographic fields are retrievable from existing core records without latency exceeding 2.5 seconds.

title: Enforce verification attempt limit and lockout referral
user_story: As a security manager, I want the system to lock out a session after 3 consecutive failed verification attempts, so that brute-force credential stuffing is blocked.
business_value: Protects bank systems from automated attack and prevents customer distress by redirecting stuck users to telephony.
acceptance_criteria: Exactly 3 consecutive verification failures locks the customer reference for self-service for 24 hours; Upon the 3rd failure, the customer is shown a secure referral message with representative contact details; System logs the lockout event with timestamp, IP hash, and failure reason code to portal metadata.
notes: Aligns with Gareth Evans requirement to prevent customer circular loops while safeguarding account access.

title: Enable representative security verification and credential reset
user_story: As a collections representative, I want to authenticate a customer who failed online verification and reset their portal credentials, so that legitimate customers can regain self-service access.
business_value: Eliminates manual dead-ends
acceptance_criteria: empowering representatives to resolve authentication blockers in under 90 seconds.
dependencies: Representative interface displays verified telephony challenge questions when an authenticated customer case is opened; Representative can trigger a one-click credential unlock/reset upon successful telephony challenge; Unlock action generates an auditable event record linking representative ID to the customer record.
notes: P1
column10: Critical ADKAR capability item: representative teams must be trained to reset access rather than taking over simple queries manually.

title: Route customer back to portal following representative reset
user_story: As a customer whose credentials were reset by a representative, I want the option to restart my session online, so that I can self-resolve without staying on the telephone.
business_value: Maximises portal adoption and frees up representative capacity immediately after clearing authentication roadblocks.
acceptance_criteria: Once a representative resets credentials, system issues an SMS/email magic re-entry link valid for 15 minutes; Customer accessing the link is brought directly to a refreshed verification screen with zeroed attempt count; If customer declines portal restart, representative is prompted to proceed with standard telephony handling.
notes: Supports representative transition target of driving self-service deflection even after inbound contact occurs.

title: Display real-time overdue balance and delinquency status
user_story: As a verified delinquent customer, I want to view my current overdue balance, total balance, and days in arrears, so that I understand my debt position clearly.
business_value: Deflects routine balance inquiries (accounting for 12.49% of all collections contacts) to automated self-service.
acceptance_criteria: Verified customer dashboard displays exact overdue amount, current balance, and arrears status fetched from legacy storage; All currency values are displayed with timestamp of last system update; If legacy database is unreachable, a graceful degradation screen displays with an apology and retry option.
notes: Read-only connection to legacy collections database. Caching layer recommended to prevent legacy database contention.

title: Display context-sensitive eligible next actions
user_story: As a verified customer, I want to see only the repayment actions I am eligible to take, so that I do not attempt unsupported resolution paths.
business_value: Eliminates customer confusion
acceptance_criteria: curtails drop-offs
dependencies: and ensures customers only proceed along policy-approved pathways.
priority: Dashboard dynamically presents available pathways (Promise to Pay, Repayment Plan, Vulnerability Self-Report) based on account status; Ineligible actions are suppressed from view rather than disabled without explanation; Customer action selection is recorded as an interaction event in portal metadata.
notes: US-05
column11: Business rules engine determines eligibility flags based on days delinquent

title: Implement session inactivity warning and safe pause
user_story: As the delivery team, I want the portal to warn the user and safely pause after 5 minutes of inactivity, so that unattended sessions do not leak financial data.
business_value: Safeguards sensitive debt data in shared environments and enables automated queue tracking for abandoned sessions.
acceptance_criteria: Modal countdown warning appears after 4 minutes of user inactivity giving 60 seconds to extend; Expiration at 5 minutes terminates authenticated session, clears sensitive DOM data, and displays timeout screen; System records session timeout event, logs last visited screen, and flags case in metadata.
notes: Directly corresponds to BPMN Subprocess Activity_11ywdyt (Session Timeout Check).

title: Evaluate automated payment plan eligibility rules
user_story: As the system, I want to evaluate customer account attributes against policy criteria, so that only manageable, policy-compliant payment plans are offered.
business_value: Mitigates default risk by ensuring self-serve plans strictly comply with credit risk policy without representative underwriting.
acceptance_criteria: Eligibility evaluation executes automatically upon customer selecting repayment plan pathway; System assesses arrears tier, account age, and active disputes, categorising account as Eligible or Unsupported; Ineligible cases are diverted to routing handler with specific policy exclusion reason code.
notes: Rule matrix agreed with Daniel Okoye (Finance/Risk) to ensure Phase 1 does not overstep into bespoke negotiation.

title: Present tailored payment plan options with schedule breakdowns
user_story: As an eligible customer, I want to review structured payment plan options with instalment amounts, so that I can select a sustainable repayment path.
business_value: Enables self-service debt restructuring
acceptance_criteria: replacing manual calculations previously conducted by telephone representatives.
dependencies: Screen presents 2 to 4 eligible instalment options detailing frequency (weekly/monthly), instalment amount, and end date; Total repayable under each option equals the outstanding arrears without hidden fees or penalties; Customer can toggle between options to compare affordability before making a binding selection.
notes: P1

title: Confirm selected payment plan and generate payment agreement
user_story: As an eligible customer, I want to confirm my chosen plan and view legal agreement terms, so that I have formal clarity on my commitment.
business_value: Secures customer commitment and provides clear audit-ready evidentiary agreement required by compliance.
acceptance_criteria: Selection screen displays chosen instalment amount, first debit date, recurring schedule, and formal declaration; Customer must actively tick statutory acknowledgment before Confirm Agreement button activates; Confirmation screen provides downloadable PDF summary and unique agreement reference code.
notes: Satisfies Daniel Okoye mandate for evidential validity on self-serve payment agreements.

title: Capture digital promise to pay with amount and commitment date
user_story: As a customer unable to pay immediately, I want to submit a Promise to Pay for a specific future date and amount, so that I avoid escalation calls.
business_value: Automates routine promise-to-pay capture (accounting for 12.08% of sample interactions)
acceptance_criteria: directly reducing representative call volume.
dependencies: Form validates that commitment date is within bank policy limit (maximum 28 days from current date); Form validates that promised amount meets minimum threshold percentage of overdue balance; Successful submission displays formal PTP receipt and pauses outbound collections contact until commitment date.
notes: P1
column10: Directly maps to BPMN Activity_1fko436 (Collect digital promise to pay).

title: Write payment commitments and schedules back to legacy database
user_story: As the core banking integration service, I want to write confirmed PTPs and plans into the legacy collections database, so that records remain synchronised.
business_value: Eliminates manual rekeying by representatives and ensures follow-up automation operates off single truth records.
acceptance_criteria: System executes transactional write of PTP/plan details (amount, due date, terms) to legacy database within 5 seconds; Write confirms success via acknowledgment token before releasing confirmation to customer; Failed writes trigger automated retry (up to 3 times) before queuing case for operational fallback.
notes: Core back-end integration touching DataStoreReference_01pf0a4 in BPMN. Must handle legacy schema constraints.

title: Route unsupported payment cases to representative queue with context
user_story: As the collections routing engine, I want to transfer unsupported plan cases to the telephony queue with attached diagnostic codes, so that cases are handled efficiently.
business_value: Protects operational continuity and prevents dropped cases when customer needs exceed Phase 1 automation rules.
acceptance_criteria: Accounts failing eligibility or rejecting offered plans are automatically queued for representative callback; Routing payload contains reason code (e.g., BALANCE_EXCEEDS_LIMIT, PLAN_REJECTED) and customer attempt history; Queue priority is assigned dynamically based on delinquency severity and balance risk tier.
notes: Solves Gareth Evans major concern: ensuring complex cases do not fall between channel cracks.

title: Support self-reported financial vulnerability and trigger collections pause
user_story: As a customer experiencing financial vulnerability, I want to notify the bank online, so that collections activities are halted while specialist care is arranged.
business_value: Guarantees regulatory compliance with FCA vulnerability guidance
acceptance_criteria: preventing inappropriate automated enforcement on vulnerable customers.
dependencies: Customer selecting Report Financial Vulnerability is presented with a supportive, non-intimidating self-declaration screen; Submission immediately applies a 30-day statutory collections hold on the account across all systems; Case is routed directly to the Specialist Vulnerability Handling queue with customer-entered context attached.
notes: P1
column10: Directly implements BPMN Subprocess Activity_1v6qc40 (Self-Report Financial Vulnerability). Non-negotiable compliance requirement.

title: Process customer request for representative telephony contact
user_story: As a customer preferring human support, I want to request representative contact from the portal, so that I can discuss my account without waiting on hold.
business_value: Reduces customer frustration
acceptance_criteria: mitigates inbound phone surges
dependencies: and organizes representative outbound call queues.
priority: Form captures preferred callback telephone number, best contact window (Morning/Afternoon), and brief topic category; System validates contact number format and creates outbound task in representative telephony queue; Confirmation screen provides estimated callback SLA and reference number.
notes: US-06
column11: Implements BPMN Activity_182g5w9 (Request Contact from representative team).

title: Display plain-language unsupported outcome and SLA messaging
user_story: As a customer whose journey cannot be completed online, I want clear, empathetic messaging explaining why, so that I understand what happens next.
business_value: Reduces customer anxiety and curbs repetitive contact attempts across other channels while awaiting resolution.
acceptance_criteria: Outcome screen uses transparent, non-punitive language explaining why the account requires representative handling; Screen explicitly outlines next steps, including who will contact whom and within what timeframe (SLA); Emergency debt advice charity contact details (e.g., StepChange, Citizens Advice) are prominently displayed.
notes: Reviewed by Compliance and Gareth Evans to guarantee customer-centric

epic: Portal interaction history and audit trail
title: Display customer portal interaction history in representative console
user_story: As a collections representative, I want to view a timeline of customer portal activity, so that I never ask customers to repeat information already provided.
business_value: Drastically reduces call handling times and eliminates representative frustration
acceptance_criteria: driving internal ADKAR desire and adoption.
dependencies: Case view console renders chronological timeline of portal interactions (screens viewed, failed attempts, plans inspected); Timeline clearly marks exact reason for channel transition or routing failure; Interaction history loads concurrently with case opening, adding zero additional clicks or screen switches.
notes: P1
column10: Directly satisfies Gareth Evans requirement: eliminates repetitive context-gathering by representative staff.

epic: Portal interaction history and audit trail
title: Record immutable timestamped audit log of key customer actions
user_story: As the compliance officer, I want tamper-evident logs of customer consent, declarations, and payment submissions, so that the bank can evidence regulatory compliance.
business_value: Satisfies FCA DISP and CONC evidentiary standards
acceptance_criteria: insulating the bank from legal challenges regarding disputed debt arrangements.
dependencies: System records UTC timestamp, customer ID, IP address, action type, and payload hash for all verifications and agreements; Audit logs are written to append-only, tamper-evident storage inaccessible to manual editing; Audit query interface allows compliance officers to extract full customer journey logs by account reference.
notes: P1
column10: Core prerequisite for Daniel Okoye sign-off on legal validity of digital arrangements.

epic: Portal interaction history and audit trail
title: Generate automated end-of-day reconciliation data extract
user_story: As a finance operations analyst, I want an automated daily extract of portal payment promises and plan agreements, so that ledger reconciliation is accurate.
business_value: Eliminates manual spreadsheet reconciliation across 50+ representatives
acceptance_criteria: restoring executive confidence in recovery figures.
dependencies: Scheduled batch service generates CSV extract at 23:59 daily containing all portal commitments created in prior 24 hours; Extract calculates total promised value, count of agreements, and legacy write-back confirmation status; Extract automatically deposits into secure finance SFTP location and notifies operations finance team.
notes: P2
column10: Maps to BPMN Group_0rd10z0 (Reconciliation Process Activity_1rjeexf).

title: Capture journey funnel completion
user_story: drop-off
business_value: and routing telemetry
acceptance_criteria: As the product manager, I want granular event tracking across every portal step, so that I can identify journey drop-off and optimize conversion.
dependencies: Provides empirical proof of portal usability and highlights bottleneck steps requiring UX revision or policy refinement.
priority: Telemetry framework captures anonymised event on every step transition (Screen View, Step Complete, Abandon, Error); System differentiates between successful self-service completion, voluntary drop-off, and automated representative routing; Telemetry data aggregates in real-time reporting datastore without impacting front-end responsiveness.
column11: Priya Nair primary requirement for data-driven product iteration during Phase 1 pilot.

title: Generate operational workload deflection and capacity shift report
user_story: As the Head of Collections Operations, I want weekly reports on call deflection and representative time saved, so that I can prove the 12-month ROI case.
business_value: Proves the 12-month payback hypothesis to Daniel Okoye and provides management visibility into operational capacity shift.
acceptance_criteria: Report compares weekly portal-resolved cases against baseline representative call handling hours (18.5 mins/call); Output quantifies hours of representative time freed up across balance checks and routine PTPs; Dashboard displays trend charts of self-service resolution rate vs. routed exceptions.
notes: Key deliverable for Daniel Okoye senior leadership briefing and Gareth Evans resource planning.
